table_title: Discharge, in second-feet, water year October 1949 to September 1950 (monthly summary block: Month / Second-foot-days / Maximum / Minimum / Mean / Runoff in acre-feet)
location_text: Water-stage recorder, lat. 38°34'05", long. 121°25'20", at H Street Bridge, just east of Sacramento, Sacramento County, 6.5 miles upstream from mouth.
quantities_units: second-foot-days; maximum discharge (second-feet); minimum discharge (second-feet); mean discharge (second-feet); runoff (acre-feet)
notes: Sampled table (2 of 2) is the monthly summary printed directly under the daily discharge grid, with no title of its own; it shares the daily table's title. Rows October 1949 to September 1950 plus totals 'Calendar year 1949' and 'Water year 1949-50' (the calendar-year row covers Jan-Dec 1949, so strictly 1949 only either way). Units of Maximum/Minimum/Mean are not printed in the summary header; second-feet taken from the title above. No station number printed. Heading 'AMERICAN RIVER BASIN'.
